audit_scope.description: These subgraphs cover CL fork transitions (Fulu), CL validator duties (custody, data column sidecars), and EL history expiry (EIP-7927). Both layers and their interfaces are in scope.

out_of_scope_reasons.Mainnet/Testnet Testing: All testing should be done on local forks of testnet or mainnet
out_of_scope_reasons.Pricing Oracles: Incorrect data supplied by third party oracles (oracle manipulation/flash loan attacks are in-scope)
out_of_scope_reasons.Third-party Smart Contracts: Any testing with third-party systems and applications is prohibited
out_of_scope_reasons.Test Files: Impacts on test files and configuration files unless stated otherwise
out_of_scope_reasons.Configuration Files: Impacts on test files and configuration files unless stated otherwise

conditional_in_scope.oracle_manipulation: Oracle manipulation and flash loan attacks are explicitly in-scope
conditional_in_scope.profitable_exploits_only: All thefts must be profitable and all freezing must be reasonably priced for the impact

misclassified_entities.reason: Beacon Chain State is an internal component of the CL, not an external entity. The validator client reads its own beacon node's state; this is an internal data dependency, not an external trust boundary crossing.

trusted_external_entities.name: Validator Client via Beacon API
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Validator clients connect to their own beacon node typically over localhost with authentication. They query proposer duties from the proposer_lookahead. The Beacon API is authenticated but input from the VC (e.g., block proposals, attestations) must still be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Execution Layer via Engine API
trusted_external_entities.rationale: EL provides blob data and cell KZG proofs to CL via JWT-authenticated Engine API. Content (cell proofs, blobs) must be validated by CL before distribution as sidecars.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Network Peer via Gossip
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers on the P2P gossip network are unauthenticated. Any peer can publish sidecars to subnet topics. All received sidecars must be fully validated (KZG proofs, Merkle inclusion, slot range).

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Network Peer via Req/Resp
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers requesting or serving data column sidecars via req/resp are unauthenticated. Responses must be validated; requests may be malicious (resource exhaustion).

trusted_external_entities.name: User via JSON-RPC
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: JSON-RPC API (eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_getBlockByHash for pre-merge data)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Public JSON-RPC interface accepting arbitrary queries. Post-history-expiry, requests for pre-merge data trigger external data retrieval paths. Input is fully untrusted.

trusted_external_entities.name: Portal Network via P2P
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Decentralized P2P network providing pre-merge historical data. Data is unauthenticated and must be validated against known block hashes before use.

trusted_external_entities.name: e2store Archive Source
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Archive data from external sources. While the format is well-defined, the source is not authenticated. Block data must be validated against canonical hashes.

trusted_external_entities.name: DevP2P Peer via eth/69 or EIP-7801
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: DevP2P protocol (historical block retrieval via EIP-7801)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P peers serving historical data are unauthenticated. All retrieved blocks must be validated against known hashes.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: VC queries are read-only for proposer duties. When VC submits blocks/attestations, content must be validated (signatures, slot correctness, proposer index matches lookahead).
CL must validate cell KZG proofs from BlobsBundle before constructing and distributing DataColumnSidecars. Invalid proofs from a buggy EL could propagate invalid sidecars to the network.

Full sidecar validation required: verify KZG proofs, Merkle inclusion proofs, slot within acceptable range, column index matches subnet, proposer signature. Reject and score down peers sending invalid sidecars.
All served/received sidecars must be validated. Rate limiting required to prevent resource exhaustion from excessive requests.

Requests for expired pre-merge data trigger external retrieval. Must not allow untrusted RPC input to cause unbounded resource consumption during external data fetching. Return errors gracefully if data unavailable.
All retrieved block data must be validated against canonical block hashes. Portal Network peers are untrusted and may serve malicious or corrupted data.
Block data from e2store archives must be validated against canonical block hashes and transaction/receipt roots. Archive source may be tampered with.
Peers serving historical blocks are untrusted. All data must be validated against canonical hashes. Rate limiting required.
